additional_info.subject: ID0371199-DC/Si-D/DK-[EHpjBf] Proactive-DC4_CableTempSensor CRM:00798001066
additional_info.body:
Hello Martin,
I hope this email finds you well. My name is Giridhar, and I’ll be assisting you with the case created in reference to the Proactive Monitoring Activity.
Below, you’ll find the relevant details regarding the product and our observations during the proactive monitoring activity.
Product: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset: MP / R3 170001645
Charger ID/Serial No.: EHpjBf
Problem Description: DC4_CableTempSensor
We could see couple of
PLC-Dispenser-Error-Flag on 'DC4_CableTempSensor_XD240' changed to true - (VIV:0 PLE:1 KON:1)
As you can see that this issue occurred in last 2 days.
indicating
'VIV:'0 → in case of an invalid sensor reading
'PLE:' 1→ in case of an plausibility error (temperature difference between +/- too high)
We need to have visual inspection of the Cable for damage, rust/water ingress.
Then, We need to validate following connections to the state monitor.
Also. Check for the resistance in P1/N1 and P2/N2.
Also, We suggest to swap the connections of the Plug 3 and Plug 4 to identify if it is cable issue or the state monitor issue.
We suggest to have both as spares while site intervention.
For your convenience, please note your case number
0371199
Kindly refer to this in all future communications related to this issue.
We will get back to on this case with the next course of action.
